origins.section: A Cover Is a Set of Projects That Cannot All Be Funded
Separation Finds a Cover the LP Point Breaks
A Gomory Cut Comes From Any Tableau Row With a Fractional Right-Hand Side

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-cover: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-cover: A cover is **minimal** when dropping any one of its projects leaves a set that fits in the budget. Minimal covers give the strongest cover inequalities.
recorded.prompt:q-separate: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-separate: Each project in the cover "costs" $`1 - x^*_i`$, how far the LP is from funding it fully, and the cover is violated when those costs add up to less than 1.
recorded.prompt:q-gomory: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-gomory: $`\sum_{j} f(\bar a_j)\, w_j \ge f(\bar b)`$ ... Watch the negative one: $`\lfloor -5/4 \rfloor = -2`$, so $`f(-5/4) = -5/4 + 2 = 3/4`$, not $`1/4`$.

recorded.prompt:q-cover:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cover:a: A cover needs $`\sum_{i \in C} c_i > B`$. Here a and d weigh 6, inside the 8, so they are not a cover.
recorded.prompt:q-cover:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cover:c: "Add P005 to the cover above and it is still a cover ..., but no longer minimal, since without P005 it is still a cover." Without d, {a, b, c} weighs 10 > 8.
recorded.prompt:q-cover:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cover:d: "The comparison is strict: a set that costs exactly $`B`$ fits, so it is not a cover, and its 'inequality' would remove a real plan."
recorded.prompt:q-separate:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-separate:b: "violated when those costs add up to less than 1". A sum of exactly 1 is not violated; also "a project at 0 costs a full 1, so a violated cover never contains one."
recorded.prompt:q-separate:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-separate:c: "the cover is violated when those costs add up to less than 1". 5/3 is not; also "a violated cover never contains one" at 0.
recorded.prompt:q-separate:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-separate:d: "a set that costs exactly $`B`$ fits, so it is not a cover". b, c and d weigh 8; also 5/3 is not below 1.
recorded.prompt:q-gomory:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gomory:a: "`int(v)` would be wrong here: it rounds toward zero ... and the 'fractional part' comes out as $`-1/4`$, which breaks the argument above." f(-0.25) = 0.75, not 0.25.
recorded.prompt:q-gomory:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gomory:b: The right side is "$`f(\bar b)`$", the fractional part 0.75, not 2.75.
recorded.prompt:q-gomory:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gomory:c: The cut reads "$`\ge f(\bar b)`$"; at the LP optimum the slacks are 0 and "the cut is broken". A <= row would hold there.
